source.original_question:
Find the area of the shaded region. Round to the nearest tenth.
Choices:
A:104.7
B:157.1
C:235.6
D:314.2

adaptations.reason: States the two equal internally tangent circles depicted in the source; all numerical measurements remain in the image.

independent_solution.method: Outer radius is 10; each equal inner circle has radius 5. Shaded area=100π-2*25π=50π≈157.1.
